sentences.text: This is the first application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.94/2021 registered at Police Station Paraswada, District Balaghat (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376, 376AB & 342 of IPC and Section 3/4 & 5(m)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 12.07.2021.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against present applicant is of committing rape with the minor prosecutrix.
On the basis of which, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 12.07.2021.

It is submitted that mother of prosecutrix has deposed in her statement that panty of her daughter was seized by police whereas police has seized leggie of prosecutrix, which shows that the prosecution case is doubtful.
DNA report is not reliable as the same is regarding leggie.
It is further submitted that in the MLC NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17164 2 MCRC-5551-2025 report, no injury is found on the body of prosecutrix.
In support of his contention, learned counsel has placed reliance on the decision of Apex Court in Irfan @ Bhayu Mevati vs. State of M.P. passed in Criminal Appeal No.1667-1668 of 2021.

sentences.text: Charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the objector as well as respondent/State have opposed the bail application and have submitted that the age of prosecutrix is approximate eight years whereas age of present applicant is about 41 years.

sentences.text: The prosecutrix and her parents have deposed against present applicant before the Trial Court.
DNA report is also positive.
It is further submitted that minute appreciation of evidence cannot be done at this stage.
Hence, the applicant do not deserve grant of bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case as well as age of the prosecutrix and act of present applicant, I am not inclined to grant regular bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.
